issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding contradictory testimony about efforts to find witnesses for the complaint letter.
issues.applicant_position: Inconsistencies reflect memory issues; the RPD improperly searched for credibility problems.
issues.respondent_position: Agrees the RPD erred on one credibility reason, but says the account was not credible overall.
issues.result_text: Testimony on witness efforts was contradictory and evolving without reasonable explanation; RPD was correct.

issues.issue: Whether the omission of village sarpanch involvement from the narrative undermines credibility.
issues.applicant_position: RPD held the omission against him and did not consider his explanation.
issues.result_text: RPD considered the explanation, found it unsatisfactory; the omission negatively affected the account.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding contradictory testimony about when he decided to leave India.
issues.applicant_position: Testimony on timing was not contradictory; RPD ignored when he began planning to leave.
issues.result_text: Testimony about timing of plans to leave was not necessarily contradictory; RAD agrees.

issues.issue: Whether the two-year delay in claiming refugee protection undermines credibility.
issues.applicant_position: Delay should not affect credibility because he had a student visa and legal status.
issues.result_text: Delay adversely affects credibility; the student visa did not explain it and reasons were unsatisfactory.

issues.issue: Whether the credibility concerns rebut the presumption of truthfulness, given the documents.
issues.result_text: Credibility concerns rebut the presumption; documents do not overcome them and conflict with testimony.
